approach: Define records_worktree_dir and records_root once in athena-data paths.rs beside repo_state_dir. Add RecordSet::load_from_dir and load_current (gate records.rs), Records::from_set and load_current (store.rs). Move live non-test readers to the current forms; give read_records and walltime callers records_root. Host the scan test inside xtask/src/main.rs as a #[cfg(test)] module (a listed deliverable) so no file outside the deliverables is added. Leave site.rs untouched. Add integration test, docs and changelog.

decisions.choice: Read the worktree as plain files (load_from_dir), sorted by path, same check_record_file and records/... relative paths
decisions.reason: No git needed in a scratch checkout; one walk serves RecordSet and Records; absence falls back to the old git-tree load.

rejected.option: resolve_tip(git) and pass the branch tip as treeish
rejected.why: Needs the branch in the current repo's refs; a scratch checkout has only the worktree.
Per-caller patches are the fault the root-cause default rejects.

decisions.choice: Worktree counts as present only if <worktree>/records is a directory; fallback decided in paths.rs and load_current
decisions.reason: One place decides; absence yields the old behavior.

rejected.why: Before cutover no worktree exists; every reader would break.

decisions.choice: Leave gate checks that judge a given treeish (jobs.rs, reconcile, history), records_import.rs, admission.rs path classes and invariant.rs unchanged
decisions.reason: They judge a candidate commit or copy main's records to the branch; they are not live readers of current state.

rejected.why: Importer would read its own destination; gate checks would ignore the commit under test.

decisions.choice: Scan test lives as a #[cfg(test)] module in xtask/src/main.rs, named records_reader_scan, matching join("records"), read_records(<repo dir>), and two-arg Records::load/RecordSet::load in non-test code (cut at #[cfg(test)])
decisions.reason: Mechanism for the single-path rule within listed deliverables (answers finding 2); shapes exclude citation strings and BOOTSTRAP_OUTCOME.

rejected.why: Outside the deliverables list; widens scope.

files.purpose: view and workspace copy use load_current
use load_current if a live reader; else untouched
use records_root/load_current at live sites if any
use current forms if it reads records; else untouched
walltime root via records_root; host records_reader_scan test module
record reader move, fallback, site out of scope, D111

steps: Add records_worktree_dir and records_root to paths.rs with unit tests.
Add RecordSet::load_from_dir and load_current in gate records.rs.
Split Records::load into load plus from_set; add Records::load_current in store.rs.
Re-grep call sites; move live non-test callers to load_current and read_records callers to records_root; skip #[cfg(test)] and treeish-judging gate/importer code.
Add the records_reader_scan test module in xtask/src/main.rs with planted-read cases.
Run xtask site with and without records/ and compare; confirm site.rs untouched.
Update docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md citing D111.
Run fmt, clippy -D warnings and full cargo test --locked.

risks.risk: A partial or stale worktree hides in-tree records
risks.mitigation: Present means <worktree>/records is a directory; fallback documented and tested.

risks.risk: Existing tests see a developer's real worktree
risks.mitigation: records_worktree_dir derives from repo_state_dir keyed by the repo's git dir, so temp repos get their own empty path.
Producer re-greps Records::load(, RecordSet::load(, read_records(; the scan test fails on any left.

risks.risk: Path ordering drift between load_from_dir and ls-tree
risks.mitigation: Sort by path; test compares both loads on identical content.

demonstrations.method: Integration test: temp repo with in-tree records/ set A and worktree (via ATHENA_STATE_DIR path from paths.rs) holding set B; call each moved reader and assert B's marker present and A's absent.
demonstrations.observes: Every reader returns the worktree's records only.
demonstrations.fails_without: A reader still loading in-tree records/ would return A and fail the worktree-only marker assertion.

demonstrations.method: With no worktree each reader equals Records::load/old result; separate test runs athena status and a forecast in a checkout with records/ removed and only the worktree populated, comparing stdout to the records/ run.
demonstrations.fails_without: A load_current that errors or returns empty when the worktree is absent, or a reader needing in-tree records/, fails the equality.

demonstrations.method: The scan test enforces that only paths.rs and the allow-listed fallback files join records/ or name records-worktree; review paths.rs for the single definition.
demonstrations.observes: Scan passes on the real tree.
demonstrations.fails_without: A second definition or direct join in a reader would be flagged and fail the scan.

demonstrations.method: One test scans the real tree (expects none) and plants temp sources with join("records") and read_records(repo_dir) in non-test code (expects findings) and a citation-only file (expects none). Output must show at least 1 passed, not 0 tests run.
demonstrations.observes: Real tree clean, planted flagged, citations unflagged; nonzero tests run.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the matchers, the planted read would not be reported and the test would fail.

demonstrations.method: Run site with records/ present, save output; run in a copy without records/; diff outputs; git status/diff shows xtask/src/site.rs unmodified.
demonstrations.fails_without: If site.rs were rooted at the worktree or records/, output would differ when records/ is absent.

demonstrations.method: Run cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings and cargo test --locked; existing tests unedited.
demonstrations.observes: All pass, including existing tests before the branch exists.
demonstrations.fails_without: If a moved reader changed behavior with no worktree, an existing test comparing old outputs would fail; a lint or format error fails fmt/clippy.

demonstrations.method: Read the diff of both files.
demonstrations.observes: Entries state the reader move, the fallback, site generator out of scope, and cite D111.
demonstrations.fails_without: Absent entries or missing D111 citation would show in the diff; the existing policy tests on decisions/changelog format would fail on a malformed entry.

open_questions: Deliverables lib.rs, audit.rs (absent), jobs.rs, records_import.rs, admission.rs: judged not live readers; producer confirms by search and leaves them unchanged if so (lib.rs only if re-exports are needed).
Whether xtask already depends on athena-data; if not, add the dependency rather than duplicate the path.
The worktree layout is assumed to be <worktree>/records/..., created by the cutover job.
